release_notes:
BD MIL OFFICE update 21 Sept 2026.
- Scanner is much faster. A 50 page scan now shares in minutes, not an hour.
- Up to 1000 pages in Scanner and Intel Scan.
- Export now shows page count and percent, with a CANCEL button.
- Big Intel Scan compile no longer closes the app.
- Photo location (GPS) and camera info are now removed from shared PDF and JPG.
- Word, PowerPoint and File Parse no longer freeze on very large files.
- PDF eraser, page organizer and Database search fixed and faster.
- Camera and Mic permission removed. App no longer asks for them.
- If update fails, uninstl prev version and instl this version.
